sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface detection by anti-HA antibody confirmed extracellular display; CEACAM3-mediated signalling (SH2-domain recruitment, phosphotyrosine assays) was measured and found functional in the tagged constructs.
sites.rationale: CEACAM3 is a type-I single-pass transmembrane protein whose signal peptide spans residues 1–34 (authoritative landmark); the mature N-terminus begins at residue 35 (K), which is extracellular. The construct naming 'HA-GFP-tagged CEACAM3' places HA first (N-terminal, extracellular) and the fluorescent protein second (C-terminal, intracellular), consistent with anti-HA surface staining. Because no residue number is stated and the mature N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus, the junction is topology-derived: insert_after_residue=34 (A→K). Python confirms seq[33]='A' and seq[34]='K'; the tag sits 118 residues from the TM boundary, well clear of any constraint. Full-length CEACAM3 constructs carrying an N-terminal HA tag followed by a fluorescent protein (GFP, Cerulean, or mKate) at the C-terminus were expressed in mammalian cells and used for surface and functional studies (PMC3493956). The 'HA-[FP]-tagged CEACAM3' naming convention places HA before the mature protein, i.e. after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 34, on the extracellular face. No specific residue number is stated in the clip.

literature_notes: L2 (PMC9418913) and L3 (PMC3493956) describe CEACAM3-mKate fusions named with mKate at the C-terminus; the C-terminus of CEACAM3 is intracellular (residues 176–252), so these are intracellular tags and are recorded in other_positions. L4 (PMC3308951) describes a CEACAM3-GFP construct (C-terminal GFP, intracellular) and mentions an HA tag whose position is not independently pinned in that clip; it is subsumed by the stronger L1 evidence for the N-terminal HA site. No ledger line reports any insertion in an internal extracellular loop of CEACAM3, so no internal sites are proposed. The single extracellular Ig-like domain (residues 35–152) contains no published internal tag insertion in the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: CEACAM3-mKate C-terminal fusion stably expressed in HL60 cells; mKate is appended after the last residue (S252) which lies in the intracellular tail (residues 176–252), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
